mutants.replacement: export function inlineIds(html){const out=[];for(const m of html.matchAll(/cid:([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)/g))out.push(m[1]);return out;}export function attachmentMap(attachments){const map=new Map();for(const a of attachments){if(/[\r\n]/.test(a.type))throw new TypeError('invalid type');const value={cid:a.cid,type:a.type,base64:Buffer.from(a.bytes).toString('base64')};if(map.has(a.cid)&&JSON.stringify(map.get(a.cid))!==JSON.stringify(value))throw new TypeError('conflicting cid');map.set(a.cid,value);}return map;}
